**#185 after-deploy reading complete** for merge `3ad4132268d6a9e0a35a515af75307315bae4de2`.

The authorized production daemon remained healthy, **PID 6411**, process start **09 Nov 01:49:16 +10:00**. Initial and post-sample pings report embedded commit `3ad4132268`, matching the resolved merge prefix; the generic `pij-rs 0.1.0` label is not source proof. The minute's two observations have the same PID/start.

| Reading, 09 Nov +10:00 | Result |
|---|---|
| Daemon minute | **01:50:54.580616 to 01:51:54.587544**, **60.006553 monotonic seconds** |
| Recorded launches | **132 to 132: +0**, **0.000/s**; all ten populated sites flat and each snapshot's site sum equals its total |
| Registrations | **12 to 12**, registration ps **17 to 17** |
| Daemon CPU | Cumulative **20.24 to 26.16 CPU seconds**: **5.92 CPU seconds**, **9.87% of one CPU** over the interval |
| RSS | **347,184 to 190,192 KiB**, **339.05 to 185.73 MiB**, **-156,992 KiB** |
| Separate machine sample | **01:52:11 to 01:52:31**, `just spawn-rate --seconds 20 --json`: **28.2 launches/s estimate**, **28.0/s sampled** |
| Machine attribution | **7.1/s other**, **20.9/s gone before attribution**; no recognized direct daemon children; **0.0/s recognized status-line runs** |

The machine sampler identified PID 6411 and made **254,641 polls**. It ran **after**, not during, the daemon minute; it costs CPU and its attributed counts are lower bounds. Truncated command labels do not prove a launch's owner. The post-sample ping also remained at 132.

This is an early post-bounce, passively observed window. The substantial RSS fall is not a measured renderer memory saving, and there is no matched feature-off workload or per-render latency measurement. Flat launch counters do not prove absence of all in-process work. No synthetic traffic, build, test, mutation or bounce was performed.

The requested #185 reading is filed. **#189 after-deploy and the joint A1+A2 reading remain owed later**, not satisfied by this window.

Raw receipts: `pr185-after-window.json`, `pr185-after-machine.json`, `pr185-after-machine-times.txt`, `pr185-after-deploy-ping.json`.
